title: Replace bouquet image with a large 🌹 emoji line above the first timed romantic line

requirements.summary: Remove the bouquet image element from TimedRomanticLines so nothing bouquet-related is displayed above the romantic lines.
acceptanceCriteria: No bouquet image is rendered above the romantic lines at any time.
The timed 3-line sequence behavior remains unchanged (timing, once-per-page-load behavior, no looping/blinking).

file_operations.description: Remove the bouquet image loading/rendering logic (including the `/assets/generated/rose-bouquet-sketch.dim_1400x900.png` reference) while keeping the existing one-time timed progression and onComplete behavior unchanged.
Remove or neutralize the now-unused bouquet-specific styling block (e.g., `.bouquet-sketch`) to avoid keeping bouquet-related presentation artifacts, without altering other layout/stage styling.

requirements.summary: Add a single text "🌹" emoji line above the first romantic line in TimedRomanticLines, styled like the existing bottom emoji line but slightly larger via font-size only.
acceptanceCriteria: A single "🌹" text emoji is visible directly above the first romantic line in the Image 1 + timed-lines section.
The 🌹 emoji is larger than the bottom 😍 emoji line via font-size styling only (no image asset).
Only one 🌹 emoji line is rendered (no duplicates).
No other copy, layout ordering, or stage flow changes are introduced beyond replacing the bouquet element with the 🌹 emoji line.

file_operations.description: Insert a single text emoji line containing exactly "🌹" directly above the first romantic line, ensuring it renders only once and does not impact the existing timed sequence flow or any existing user-facing text.
Add a new CSS class for the 🌹 line that matches the look/spacing/animation of `.lip-biting-emoji-line` but uses a larger font-size (font-size only) so the 🌹 is visibly bigger than the 😍 line.

requirements.summary: Update the generated-assets verification script to stop requiring the removed bouquet asset while keeping other asset checks intact.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/scripts/verify-generated-assets.mjs` does not list `rose-bouquet-sketch.dim_1400x900.png` as a required asset.
Build fails if any still-required assets are missing (envelope, dog-holding-rose, lip-biting image), and succeeds without the bouquet asset present.

file_operations.description: Remove `rose-bouquet-sketch.dim_1400x900.png` from the REQUIRED_ASSETS list while keeping verification for `envelope-textured.dim_1400x900.png`, `dog-holding-rose.jpg`, and `lip-biting-emoji-cartoon.dim_900x1100.png` unchanged.
